findings.issue: זה is a masculine singular demonstrative; «estas» is feminine plural, smoothed to agree with «veces».
Qal perfect 3ms יָרַט, with הַדֶּרֶךְ as subject, is a bare participle «precipitado», which can be read as passive rather than as the finite qal predication.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens, including tú 2ms, Jehová, common-noun adversario, and על־מה kept as sobre qué.
